description: This file defines simple methods used for order management in the Order module of an Apache OFBiz-based system, including permission checks and order status updates.

methods.name: orderAdjustmentPermissionCheck
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to create or edit order adjustments, setting appropriate permission flags and messages.

methods.name: updateOrderStatusFromReceipt
methods.description: Updates the order status based on shipment receipts, marking items as completed and potentially marking the entire order as completed.
